title: Invert the actual monotone map pointwise with a Holder bound
statement: ROOT consequence: K(E)>=3|E|_k^4/(16m) and the finite secant give [T(F)-T(G)]:(F-G)>=3|F-G|_k^4/(16m). The radial identity T(F):F=4K(F), continuity and the Brouwer outward-boundary argument give surjectivity; strict monotonicity gives injectivity. Holder yields |T^-1(P)-T^-1(Q)|_k<=(16m/3)^(1/3)|P-Q|_(k,dual)^(1/3), the dual norm weighting first column by1/k. This is pointwise existence/uniqueness and a quantitative modulus, not an efficient exact inversion algorithm. Inversion need not preserve gradient curl compatibility and does not replace the original stress lambda cof F+ell T. No new priority claim or checker execution.
